info.title: Agentum Global Entity Resolver API
info.description: Deterministic global corporate entity resolution (UK Companies House, Swiss ZEFIX, Australian ABR, Singapore ACRA, US SEC EDGAR, European Registries, and Worldwide GLEIF LEI), live EU Commission VIES VAT validation, and OFAC/EU/UN sanctions screening for autonomous AI agents. Supports HTTP 402 via Coinbase x402 v2 and Stripe/Tempo MPP.

post.summary: Deterministic Global Corporate Entity & Registry Resolver
post.description: Deterministic Global Corporate Entity & Registry Resolver. Resolves official national corporate registry records, company status, and business identifiers worldwide across primary commercial jurisdictions (including US, UK, EU-27, Switzerland, Australia, Singapore, and global LEI). Accepts company names, domains, or national registration numbers with optional ISO country code.

query.description: Company name, domain, or registration number (LEI, CIK, EIN, UK Company No, Swiss UID, ABN/ACN, UEN, JAR, VAT)

jurisdiction.description: Optional 2-letter ISO country code (e.g. GB, CH, AU, SG, US, LT, DE) or auto-detected

verifyVat.description: Verify EU VAT number against live VIES if available

includeParent.description: Include parent and ultimate parent LEI relationships

checkSanctions.description: Cross-screen entity against OFAC SDN & EU Financial Sanctions (default true)

includeOfficers.description: Include corporate directors, executives, and officers when available

402.description: Payment Required — returns PAYMENT-REQUIRED (x402 v2) and WWW-Authenticate: Payment (Stripe/Tempo MPP) headers

post.summary: Verify EU VAT registration status via VIES
post.description: Validates European Union VAT identification numbers against the live official EU VIES system, linking against known company profiles.

vatNumber.description: EU VAT number including 2-letter country prefix (e.g. 'LT100004278519')

402.description: Payment Required — returns PAYMENT-REQUIRED (x402 v2) and WWW-Authenticate: Payment (Stripe/Tempo MPP) headers

post.summary: Screen entity or individual against global sanctions lists
post.description: Performs fuzzy and exact sanctions screening against OFAC SDN and EU Financial Sanctions with configurable similarity thresholds.

name.description: Entity or individual name to screen

registrationNumber.description: Optional company registration, LEI, or tax ID

402.description: Payment Required — returns PAYMENT-REQUIRED (x402 v2) and WWW-Authenticate: Payment (Stripe/Tempo MPP) headers

post.summary: All-in-one 1-shot vendor KYB due diligence & compliance verdict
post.description: Composite autonomous KYB vendor due diligence tool. Concurrently resolves corporate identity across global registers, validates European Commission VIES VAT numbers, and screens global sanctions (OFAC/EU/UN). Returns a definitive compliance verdict (APPROVED, FLAGGED_FOR_REVIEW, or REJECTED) with a full audit trail in a single round trip.

name.description: Legal or trade name of the vendor/counterparty

vatNumber.description: EU VAT number with 2-letter country prefix (e.g. 'DE129274202')

registrationNumber.description: National registration number (CRN, UID, ABN, UEN, CIK, or LEI)

402.description: Payment Required — returns PAYMENT-REQUIRED (x402 v2) and WWW-Authenticate: Payment (Stripe/Tempo MPP) headers

post.summary: Verify SEPA / international IBAN format, checksum, and country alignment
post.description: Validates International Bank Account Numbers (IBAN) using ISO 13616 specifications and MOD-97 checksum validation. Verifies whether the issuing country matches the expected corporate jurisdiction to prevent invoice fraud and redirection attacks.

iban.description: International Bank Account Number (IBAN), spaces permitted

expectedCountry.description: Expected 2-letter ISO country code of the payee/vendor (e.g. 'DE')

payeeName.description: Optional legal payee name to cross-check against bank account jurisdiction

402.description: Payment Required — returns PAYMENT-REQUIRED (x402 v2) and WWW-Authenticate: Payment (Stripe/Tempo MPP) headers

post.summary: Batch resolve multiple corporate entities concurrently (up to 25)
post.description: Concurrently resolves multiple corporate entity names, registration numbers, or domains across national registries. Optimized for agent data pipelines, CSV processing, and batch supplier onboarding.

query.description: Company name, domain, or registration number

items.description: List of entities to resolve (1 to 25 items)

402.description: Payment Required — returns PAYMENT-REQUIRED (x402 v2) and WWW-Authenticate: Payment (Stripe/Tempo MPP) headers
